```yaml
name: Beyla Integration Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  generate-matrix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.generate.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate integration test matrix
        id: generate
        env:
          WEIGHTS_FILE: internal/test/integration/beyla_weights.json
        run: |
          echo "matrix=$(./scripts/generate-integration-matrix.sh)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        shell: bash

  integration-tests:
    needs: generate-matrix
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64]
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.generate-matrix.outputs.matrix) }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download
        shell: bash

      - name: Run integration test ${{ matrix.test }}
        run: |
          go test -v ./internal/test/integration/${{ matrix.test }}
        shell: bash
```
